## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior, its motivation, and which systems/workspaces it affects.

## Verification

- [ ] Typecheck / frontend and backend build
- [ ] Relevant regression tests
- [ ] GM/player permissions and data visibility checked
- [ ] Existing campaigns and saved data remain compatible, or a reversible migration is documented
- [ ] No private campaign names, characters, assets, chat histories, credentials, or local data included

## SmugVTT-specific features

- [ ] If this adds or changes a feature unique to SmugVTT, update **README.md** with what users can actually do and the release status
- [ ] Update **CHANGELOG.md** with the new feature or fix
- [ ] Distinguish a working public release from local prototypes or planned functionality
- [ ] Describe gameplay value; branding-only changes are not listed as functional features

## Upstream attribution

Retain CozyVTT attribution, licensing notices and third-party terms.
